This role ensures complete financial compliance, accurate accounting, property budgeting, and financial reporting. Additionally, the Senior Accountant handles high-level tax compliance, leads property setups, coordinates external audits, drives process improvements, and provides mentorship to junior team members. Responsibilities I. Financial Reporting & Statements: Prepare accurate financial statements (balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements) compliant with strata accounting standards, ensuring timely delivery to property managers and stakeholders. II. Building Set Up & Tax Compliance: Manage new building setups, execute GST-BAS lodgments, and oversee full tax compliance across strata portfolios. III. Audit Coordination: Facilitate external audits, collaborate with auditors, provide documentation, and resolve audit findings within designated timelines. IV. Process Improvement & Leadership: Streamline accounting workflows, establish financial best practices, and provide direct guidance, supervision, and mentorship to junior and mid-level finance staff. V. Advanced Financial Operations: Oversee AP management, payment runs, daily bank reconciliations, property budget drafting, levy striking, debt recovery, and complex year-end fund reallocations. Requirements A. Education • Bachelor’s Degree in Accountancy or Finance (CPA certification is a major advantage). B. Experience • Minimum of 4–5+ years of accounting experience, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role handling complex financial reporting and tax compliance (BPO/offshore strata experience highly preferred). C. Technical Skills • Advanced knowledge of general ledger, financial reporting standards, GST/BAS, and tax filing processes. • Expert proficiency in MS Excel (advanced formulas, financial modeling, pivot tables). • High proficiency in specialized property management and strata accounting software. D. Soft Skills • Exceptional leadership, mentorship, and team collaboration skills. • Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking capabilities. • Excellent written and verbal English communication for stakeholder engagement and auditor liaising.
